title: Family B: a linearly stable family of planar periodic three-body orbits whose topology is not in the published lists
description:
A one-parameter family of symmetric periodic orbits of the planar three-body problem (G = 1, zero angular momentum, m1 = m2 = 1, isosceles collinear initial conditions), free-group word ABABABAbabababaB, linearly stable for m3 from 4.21 to 5.034 (30-digit samples; at m3 ≈ 4.5468718 one index touches −2 without crossing it, a consequence of a half-period symmetry). Its word occurs in none of the published lists checked (Li & Liao 2017, Li, Jing & Liao 2018, Šuvakov & Dmitrašinović 2013, Hristov et al.), at any mass. At m3 = 5: a = 0.79623821011254661853007106578327, b = 1.77433055827060488061484304997624, T = 19.25669842976743050033657405267752, stability indices 1.47916 and 1.43911. Includes the 30-digit data along the family, a second candidate (family A), and the verification code.

"Not in the lists" means: not in the lists we know and checked; Hristov et al. cover equal masses only, Li, Jing & Liao list one orbit per class from the square 0 < a, b < 1, outside which family B lies.
